caption: Castello di Bardi, Bardi
composition: Medieval fortress on a sheer rocky cliff spur above the Ceno valley · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks up at the Castello di Bardi from the rocky slope below, the fortress filling the upper half of the frame. The tall crenellated keep rises at the center-left, with round bastions and curtain walls stepping down the spur to the right. The modelled 23 September 2026, 10:50 light is bright and clear on the weathered stone, while the forested hills of the Ceno valley roll away green to the right and a rough path climbs the bare rock at the left.
